text:
Noah (AR): FYI Trellis Labs (acct: TRELLIS-9) invoice INV-6118 failed on card - 2 attempts. Support ticket 9583.

Keisha (Payments): Stripe decline code `card_declined` / `insufficient_funds`. Auto-retry schedule remaining: +24h.

Elena (Support): Customer says treasury can do ACH today but needs beneficiary NAME and routing format. They asked if we accept Fedwire or same-day ACH.

Keisha (Payments): We support Fedwire and same-day ACH for USD. ACH verification via micro-deposits = 48-72h unless they use same-bank instant ACH. Recommend offering both: ACH (slower) and wire (same-day).

Noah (AR): Can we pause suspension? It's a strategic account.

payments-bot: Policy override request created for INV-6118: hold grace 72h pending payment method confirmation.

Keisha (Payments): I'll generate redacted payment PDF and upload to secure://payments/wires/trellis_INV-6118_redacted.pdf. Do not paste account numbers here.

Elena (Support): Sent secure link in ticket 9583. Customer will confirm which path they choose.

Noah (AR): If they pick ACH, set a reminder for 72h to confirm micro-deposits. If wire, reconcile immediately on receipt and mark invoice paid.

Keisha (Payments): Scheduling one final automated retry in 6 hours per new retry policy.

Elena (Support): Closing loop until customer replies.
